description: Lärmbelastungskataster Strassen (Tag) (UR) is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoinformation Kanton Uri. Der Kanton (kantonale Vollzugsbehörde) ist nach Art. 37 (LSV) verpflichtet, für seine Strassen einen Lärmbelastungskataster zu führen und diesen periodisch zu aktualisieren. Der Lärmbelastungskataster für Haupt- und übrige Strassen ist ein wichtiges Informations- und Planungsinstrument für die Behörden in der Raumplanung und in der Beurteilung des Umweltzustand Lärmbelastung. Coverage: Geoinformation Kanton Uri. The portal files it under the publisher Geoinformation Kanton Uri. It offers 2 resource(s) in WFS, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
